subject.title: [Bug]: Discord elevated allowFrom fallback from channels.discord.allowFrom does not work on 2026.3.22

question: Should Discord elevated auth restore fallback from `channels.discord.allowFrom` when `tools.elevated.allowFrom.discord` is omitted, or should elevated exec require an explicit Discord elevated allowlist?
rationale: The reported behavior is a security-sensitive elevated exec authorization boundary, current main now documents no bundled fallback, and the open fix would intentionally change who can enable elevated host execution.

options.title: Restore narrow Discord fallback
options.body: Implement the fallback in the Discord/plugin-owned path, keep explicit empty `tools.elevated.allowFrom.discord` as an override, and make runtime plus `sandbox explain` use the same resolver.

options.title: Require explicit elevated allowlist
options.body: Keep current main behavior, update public guidance if needed, and close the fallback PRs/issues as not planned for security clarity.

options.title: Split diagnostics only
options.body: Fix `sandbox explain` to better report the missing explicit elevated allowlist while leaving authorization unchanged.

recommendation.title: Restore narrow Discord fallback
recommendation.body: Implement the fallback in the Discord/plugin-owned path, keep explicit empty `tools.elevated.allowFrom.discord` as an override, and make runtime plus `sandbox explain` use the same resolver.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the best available current-main routing candidate from the central elevated/runtime and Discord files in the local history.
